item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00490","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C01","C23","C14"],"selected_candidate_label":"C01","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C01 is the direct earlier assignment letter to the same chairman and board, and the child expressly recapitulates its central operative material: the appointment of Rockefeller, the Board's first task of considering the Gordon Gray Report's proposals for underdeveloped areas, the requested timing, and the relationship of that work to Point IV and foreign-economic policy. The child then reports completion of precisely that assignment and uses the earlier letter's substantive framing of international development, an expanding world economy, and the security of the free world. This is concrete shared drafting and a parallel request-to-completion administrative structure, not merely common subject matter. C23 and C14 share some of the foreign-economic and Point IV framing, but neither matches the child as closely in addressee, institutional machinery, or sequence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"You will recall that on November twenty-fourth I appointed the members of the International Development Advisory Board... I nominated Mr. Nelson Rockefeller as the Chairman of the Board.","parent_excerpt":"At the time I requested you to serve as Chairman of the Advisory Board on International Development...","explanation":"The child explicitly recalls the appointment and assignment embodied in C01, with the same board and chairman."},{"child_excerpt":"At that time I requested the Board to undertake as its first task a consideration of the proposals of the Gordon Gray Report concerning our policy toward the underdeveloped areas.","parent_excerpt":"I stated that I was asking you to have the Advisory Board \"as its first task, consider Mr. Gray's proposals concerning our policy toward the underdeveloped areas in the context of the full report\"","explanation":"This is highly distinctive, substantially repeated language describing the identical first task."},{"child_excerpt":"The International Development Advisory Board has now completed that task and has submitted a report to me","parent_excerpt":"I am hopeful that you may find it possible to make your recommendations to me by the beginning of February of next year.","explanation":"The child is structurally the completion-and-transmittal counterpart to C01's request for recommendations."},{"child_excerpt":"International partnership is necessary to build an expanding world economy... strengthening... the free world.","parent_excerpt":"vital to the attainment of our goal of an expanding world economy and to the building of the security of the free world.","explanation":"The child reuses C01's substantive framing linking international economic development, an expanding world economy, and free-world security."}]}
